## Custom GUI Mod v1.2.1

### Added
- Added an in-game Admin / Test Panel.
- Added UUID-based admin access and online player selection.
- Added admin tools for runes, resources and custom mobs.

### Fixed
- Fixed Admin Panel text-field alignment.

### Other
- Rune awakening now uses left click instead of middle click.

### Download
Use the attached `customguimod-1.2.1.jar`.

**Full Changelog:** [v1.2.0...v1.2.1](https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-mod/compare/v1.2.0...v1.2.1)
